regime_context: China A-shares show an extremely narrow, one-narrative tape: Coal is the sole eligible and dominant theme (rank 1, score 0.99), while breadth of rotation is just 9% (2 of 22 eligible). The absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on this market's history (gate_helps=false) and relative momentum rank-IC is weak, so this state is a coincident concentration read, not a return signal. Track record dir_accuracy is 0.337 — below coin-flip — so conviction must default low.
emerging_watch: Watch for a confirmed handoff from Coal to Gold Miners (rank 2, score 0.935) — Gold is currently ineligible (trend gate failed) but is the closest challenger. The condition that would retire this watch: Gold Miners becomes eligible AND its durability_bar rises above 0.52 while Coal loses eligibility or drops below rank 2, checked any time before 2026-11-13.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only theme with BOTH eligibility (trend gate passed) and leadership (rank 1, one_narrative=true). Durability_bar is middling at 0.52 and the hurst tag is mean-revert, which argues against chasing strength — but within an experimental/display regime the only structure the detector permits is to acknowledge where flow concentrates. This is a conditional 'maintain, don't chase' lean: the trend gate is the lone validated-ish leg and it is currently passed.
evidence: absolute_trend_gate passed (eligible) despite backtest showing it did_NOT_hold_here
theses.dissent: Coal has a mean-revert hurst tag and durability_bar of only 0.52 — on a mean-reverting tape (gate_helps=false), the top theme is historically more likely to whipsaw than to sustain. The 0.52 durability is the weakest among the top three themes, and breadth of 0.5 means leadership is not broad-based.

falsifier.text: Coal ETF 515220.SS closes below its 20-day moving average before the check-by date of 2026-11-13

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks carry the highest crowding_z (1.83, crowded=true) and a high durability_bar (0.83) but remain rank 3. Crowding here is a size-down caution — not a fade or short per guardrails — but combined with crowded=true and being second-tier in the rotation, the coherent read is to avoid adding exposure, not to bet against the theme. This is a no-action lean, not a bearish call.
evidence: rank=3, eligible=true but not the leader
theses.dissent: Banks have the strongest durability_bar (0.83) and full breadth (1.0) — the trend itself is healthy and broad. Avoiding a durable, eligible theme purely on crowding could miss continued strength; crowding only down-sizes, it has no forward edge.

falsifier.text: Banks ETF 512800.SS outperforms the CSI 300 by more than 4% over the next 20 trading days
